description: Compare two Marketcaper assets and return relative size or a supported hypothetical price-at-size scenario, the canonical pair URL, and an optional hosted image URL. Hosted images are PNG, generated on demand, share a 10 images/day/IP limit, and may require a longer timeout than the MCP JSON call. Check the input observation times and always cite the returned source_url when using the data.

asset_a.description: Canonical slug, ticker/code, or supported alias for asset A.

asset_b.description: Canonical slug, ticker/code, or supported alias for asset B.

include_image.description: When true, include a hosted Marketcaper export image URL for the pair. Hosted images are generated on demand as PNG, share a 10 images/day/IP limit, and clients should allow up to 20 seconds for the image fetch.

response_format.description: Optional output format. Use "json" when a client needs machine-parseable text blocks, especially for Claude artifacts.

name: compare_assets
title: Compare assets
